page_title: CRE 0-2 INT | Cremonese v Inter 01/02/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' That's it for today, Davide Massa has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+6' Giuseppe Pezzella (Cremonese) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Davide Massa blows for a foul.
90+5' Substitution. Youssef Maleh is replaced by Dennis Johnsen (Cremonese).
90+3' Romano Floriani (Cremonese) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders.

90+2' Federico Dimarco (Inter) unleashed a monstrous piledriver. He controlled a pass, glanced up at goal and shot from the edge of the box. It could have been a difficult one for the keeper, but the ball fortunately hit one of the defenders and ball bounced away.
90' 6 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' Davide Massa blows his whistle after Youssef Maleh (Cremonese) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle.
86' Jamie Vardy (Cremonese) argues strongly with the referee and is awarded a yellow card. A needless yellow card!
86' Jamie Vardy (Cremonese) commits a foul after unfairly battling his opponent for the ball.
84' Alessio Zerbin (Cremonese) shakes his head in disbelief after spurning a great chance. He pounced on the rebound and smashed the ball against the right post!
84' The referee blows his whistle as Matteo Darmian (Inter) was too aggressive in his challenge.
83' Marcus Thuram (Inter) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Davide Massa saw the whole situation.
82' It's time for a substitution. Andy Diouf (Inter) comes on in place of Petar Sucic.

80' Marcus Thuram (Inter) outmuscles the defender near the penalty spot and get his head to a cross from Alessandro Bastoni. The accuracy is lacking, however, and the ball spins well wide of the right post.
79' Romano Floriani (Cremonese) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
75' Davide Nicola has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Romano Floriani (Cremonese) replacing Alberto Grassi.
75' Dangerous play by Alberto Grassi (Cremonese). Davide Massa blows his whistle for a foul.
74' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Ange-Yoan Bonny (Inter) is coming onto the pitch as Lautaro Martinez cannot continue after picking up an injury.
73' What was Federico Baschirotto (Cremonese) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
71' A clumsy foul by Lautaro Martinez (Inter) and Davide Massa blows his whistle.
68' Federico Dimarco (Inter) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
67' Federico Dimarco (Inter) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.
67' Davide Nicola has decided to substitute Federico Ceccherini and he is replaced by Mikayil Faye (Cremonese).
67' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Federico Bonazzoli trots off the pitch and is replaced by Milan Djuric (Cremonese).
66' Federico Dimarco (Inter) attempts to find one of his teammates with a sweet pass into the box, but one of the defending players reacts well and intercepts the effort.
65' An attempted cross from Federico Dimarco (Inter) is cleared.
63' Youssef Maleh (Cremonese) commits a rough foul. Davide Massa stops the game and makes a call.
60' That will be all from Francesco Pio Esposito who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Marcus Thuram (Inter).
60' Here is a change. Davide Frattesi is going off and Cristian Chivu gives the last tactical orders to Henrikh Mkhitaryan (Inter).
60' We are about to witness a subsitution. Matteo Darmian (Inter) for Luis Henrique.
58' A player from Inter commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
56' Federico Dimarco (Inter) swings in a promising cross from the free kick, but one of the defenders does a perfect job to avert the danger.
54' Federico Ceccherini (Cremonese) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
53' Alessio Zerbin (Cremonese) floats the free kick into the box, but it's easily cleared by the first man.
53' It looks like Alessandro Bastoni (Inter) saw red with that tackle. Davide Massa won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
52' The game gets underway again after that interruption.
49' The game is interrupted.
49' Emil Audero (Cremonese) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
46' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Cremonese, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
46' Yann Bisseck (Inter) knocks his opponent down with an over-the-top tackle.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+2' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45' 1 additional min. will be played.
44' Alessio Zerbin (Cremonese) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Davide Massa no option but to blow his whistle.
40' Federico Dimarco (Inter) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area.
40' Federico Dimarco (Inter) whips in the resulting set piece but it's cleared.
38' Federico Ceccherini (Cremonese) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
36' Youssef Maleh (Cremonese) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
36' Davide Frattesi (Inter) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows for a foul after seeing the whole situation.
32' Francesco Folino (Cremonese) was too forceful with his tackle and Davide Massa interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
31' 0 - 2 Piotr Zielinski (Inter) takes a great first touch to control a killer pass on the edge of the box and curls the ball into the top right corner in trademark fashion.
31' Alessio Zerbin (Cremonese) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
29' Davide Frattesi (Inter) latches onto the ball in the penalty box and takes a first-time effort that goes a couple of yards over the crossbar.
26' The resulting corner, taken by Federico Dimarco (Inter), comes to nothing.

21' Alessio Zerbin (Cremonese) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Davide Massa with no other option than to blow for a foul.
20' The resulting corner from Federico Dimarco (Inter) is cleared by the defence.
20' Lautaro Martinez (Inter) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
18' The ball rebounds off the defender into the path of Federico Ceccherini (Cremonese), who immediately strikes for goal from inside the box but sends it a whisker wide of the left post.
18' Cremonese have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

16' 0 - 1 It's in the back of the net! Lautaro Martinez (Inter) gets on the scoresheet after converting a chance from the resulting corner kick. He finds himself some space inside the box and plants a perfect header inside the right post. 0:1.
16' Federico Dimarco (Inter) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.
15' Federico Dimarco (Inter) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
13' Lautaro Martinez (Inter) has a sight of goal and shoots from long range but his ambitious effort flies just wide of the right post.
12' Close! Petar Sucic (Inter) unleashes a rocket of a shot from the edge of the box and his shot flies just a few inches over the crossbar.
10' Luis Henrique (Inter) connects with a precise cross inside the goalmouth and shoots. One of the defending players reacts in time and clears the ball to safety.
9' Handball by Francesco Pio Esposito (Inter).

8' Francesco Pio Esposito (Inter) attempts to convert a cross into a goal, but his promising header from near the penalty spot towards the bottom left corner is denied by a decent save from Emil Audero.
7' Yann Bisseck (Inter) plays a dangerous chip pass into the box in an attempt to set up one of his teammates, but the effort is intercepted by one of the defenders.
6' What a miss! A floated cross from the flank picks out Alessio Zerbin (Cremonese) unmarked near the penalty spot with just the keeper to beat, but he skies his header miles over the bar.
4' Federico Baschirotto (Cremonese) commits a rough challenge and Davide Massa blows his whistle for a foul.
